description: For any acceptable numberings \(\psi,\theta\) with supplied compilers, the actual maps \(T=\pi_\theta\circ\kappa_\psi\) and \(S=\pi_\psi\circ\kappa_\theta\) are total computable, satisfy \(S\circ T=\operatorname{id}\) and \(T\circ S=\operatorname{id}\), and preserve every partial value: \(\theta_{T(n)}(x)\simeq\psi_n(x)\) and \(\psi_{S(n)}(x)\simeq\theta_n(x)\) for all \(n,x\).
